receipt_statuses.passed: all canonical gates passed against one exact clean source snapshot whose tracked bytes and executable semantics match HEAD
receipt_statuses.development_dirty: all canonical gates passed against one stable but dirty or HEAD-divergent source snapshot; never release-admissible
receipt_statuses.static_only: static gates ran but Rust qualification was unavailable or deliberately skipped; never release-admissible
receipt_statuses.failed: qualification stopped before every canonical gate passed; never release-admissible

limitations: a local qualification receipt does not establish a native DFHack build
a local qualification receipt does not establish disposable-fort live evidence
a local qualification receipt does not create a compatibility-registry entry
a local qualification receipt does not advance a deployment floor
a local qualification receipt does not qualify a release server binary
a local qualification receipt does not authorize a process launch
two-phase source snapshots detect endpoint drift but do not prove that no transient modification was reverted during gate execution
ignored untracked files are not included in the tracked source snapshot and must not influence qualified builds
